> Thanks for the clear options. Quick clarification: I accepted a calendar invite that shows 09:00 on your invite but my calendar renders it as 00:00 on Aug 27 JST — so I worry participants in Tokyo will see it as midnight.

Good catch. Internal note: when we create invites from a US-based calendar account the event timezone sometimes stays set to the creator’s timezone while the visual time converts for attendees — that can flip the date in Japan. For this thread I’ll: 1) create the event with Asia/Tokyo timezone explicitly, 2) include start times in the event title (e.g., “10:00 JST / 09:00 SGT / 11:00 AEST”), and 3) add a short note in the description about local time equivalences.

So, Hana — we’ll propose 10:00 JST (09:00 SGT / 11:00 AEST) as the primary, with 15:00 JST as a backup. If that works I’ll send a new invite from an Asia/Tokyo TZ calendar.

Karthik
